messages:
arian: we need a safety-net for the continuous-batcher: eviction + a controlled slowpath. short thread to capture proto.

mika: agreed. leaning toward per-tenant ledger (leaky-bucket) to pay for slowpath; prevents runaway.

jordan: proto: admission tries to coalesce up to T ms. if no batch -> return SLOWPATH with reason. runtime checks ledger: if credits>=S then consume and go to slowpath microbatch pipeline; else escalate to FASTPATH.

sana: slowpath should prefer short-prefix requests (prefix_hint) to reduce KV misses. include the hint in internal metadata.

arian: default params suggestion: cap=800, refill=8/sec, slow_cost=40, fast_cost=120; prototyping values.

mika: add damping: require K consecutive slow signals before scheduler honors a DRAIN_REQUEST. jitter refills to avoid synchronized storms.

jordan: telemetry: tag path_taken and headroom_balance percentile. emit events when headroom<10%.

sana: testing: sim 10k tenants, Pareto arrivals; chaos test disabling coalescing on nodes. aim p50 unchanged, p99 within 10%.

ci-bot: PR checklist -> batcher:admission-codes, scheduler:drain-api, runtime:slowpath, infra:tenant-ledger, telemetry:metrics. reviewers @arian @mika @jordan @sana.

arian: i'll write RFC follow-up with sequence diagram and sim numbers. thanks.
